content: Table TABREF19 compares classifier performance using the oos-binary scheme. In-scope accuracy suffers for all models using the undersampling scheme when compared to training on the full dataset using the oos-train and oos-threshold approaches shown in Table TABREF14. However, out-of-scope recall improves compared to oos-train on Full but not OOS+. Augmenting the out-of-scope training set appears to help improve both in-scope and out-of-scope performance compared to undersampling, but out-of-scope performance remains weak.
